items.name: Mute
items.help: No voice for any session. The mute key (Ctrl+Alt+M) does the same.

items.name: Volume
items.help: The voice and the short sounds together.

items.name: Speed
items.help: How fast the voice talks.

items.name: Language of the Summary
items.help: The spoken line in the language you wrote or spoke in, or always in one language.

items.name: Say the Session Name
items.help: Its name as the overlay shows it, from its folder, said before each of its lines so you know who talks without looking.

items.name: Voice Made On
items.help: Where the voice is made. The graphics card (NVIDIA) starts each line sooner; Automatic uses it when there is one.
Each session speaks in its own voice, so you know who is talking. New projects take the ticked voices in order, and keep the one they get.

items.name: Talking to a Busy Session
items.help: Your words reach a session that is working at its next step, as typed ones do, or at the end of its reply.

items.name: Side Questions
items.help: Start with "by the way" while a session works: the answer is spoken at once, and the session neither sees the question nor changes course.

items.name: Confirm Before Sending
items.help: Your words wait on the light until you tap the talk key (Ctrl+Alt+Space) again.

items.name: Cancel Key Interrupts Claude
items.help: Like Ctrl+C: with nothing else to cancel, the cancel key (Ctrl+Alt+Backspace) stops the work of the session in focus. The session stays open.

items.name: Clear the Chat by Voice
items.help: Say "clear the chat" and /clear is typed into that session's terminal once it is at its prompt. Needs the VS Code extension.

items.name: Mixed Languages
items.help: When one message goes from one of your languages to another, each part is written in its own. It splits where you pause.

items.name: Transcribe On
items.help: Where your words are written down. The graphics card (NVIDIA) is faster and uses a larger model that gets more words right; Automatic uses it when there is one.

items.name: Keep My Recordings
items.help: Every recording is saved with the words it was heard as, to train a model of your own voice later. They stay on this computer.

items.name: Release Delay
items.help: After you let go of the talk key (Ctrl+Alt+Space), it keeps listening this long, so your last word is not cut off.

items.name: Layout
items.help: A bar of lights at the side, or an island at the top. The layout key (Ctrl+Alt+K) switches them.

items.name: Details
items.help: What the overlay shows beside the lights. The details key (Ctrl+Alt+L) goes through them.

items.name: Glass Effect
items.help: How much of what is behind shows through, blurred. 0 is plain dark glass.

items.name: Size
items.help: How big the bar, the details and the bubble are drawn. Windows' own display scale comes on top of this.

items.name: Reduce Motion
items.help: The overlay opens and changes at once, with no springs, slides or glints. It is on by itself while Windows' animation effects are off.

items.name: History Shows
items.help: What was said last, when the mouse rests on the details: by this session, or by all of them.

items.name: History in Selected Session
items.help: In the Selected Session view, what it said last: always in its card, or only when the mouse rests on the details.

items.name: Time in the History
items.help: How long ago each line was said.

items.name: Plan Usage
items.help: The five-hour window and the week, at the foot of the details.

items.name: Working
items.help: The light of a session at work.

items.name: Needs You
items.help: A session waiting for an answer, and the edge and keys of its request.

items.name: Done
items.help: A session that has finished its turn.

items.name: Failed
items.help: A session whose turn ended in an error.

items.name: Idle
items.help: A session with nothing going on.

items.name: Glass
items.help: The color of the glass. Dark ones keep the words readable.

items.name: Microphone
items.help: The light, bars and wave of the session you are talking to.

items.name: Terminal Color
items.help: A little of its session's color in a terminal's background.

items.name: Color Strength
items.help: How much of the color goes into the background.

items.name: Flash When the Focus Moves
items.help: The terminal lights up for a moment when you move the focus to it.

items.name: Clicking a Terminal Selects It
items.help: Going to a terminal in the editor selects its session in the overlay.

items.name: Switching Moves the Keyboard
items.help: Moving between sessions with the keys or the wheel puts the keyboard in its terminal.

items.name: Talk
items.help: Hold it and speak to the session in focus.

items.name: Cancel or Stop
items.help: Drops a recording, takes back words not yet sent, cuts the line being spoken, or stops the turn.

items.name: Mute
items.help: Turns the voice off for every session, and on again.

items.name: Say It Again
items.help: Repeats the last line of the session in focus.

items.name: Allow
items.help: Allows what a session asks to do. With answers to tick, it confirms them.

items.name: Deny
items.help: Refuses what a session asks to do.

items.name: Answer 1
items.help: Picks an answer when a session asks a question.

items.name: Previous Session (Bar)
items.help: Moves the focus up the bar.

items.name: Next Session (Bar)
items.help: Moves the focus down the bar.

items.name: Previous Session (Island)
items.help: Moves the focus left in the island.

items.name: Next Session (Island)
items.help: Moves the focus right in the island.

items.name: Details
items.help: Steps through: the bar only, every session, the session in focus.

items.name: Switch Layout
items.help: Swaps the bar and the island.

items.name: Settings
items.help: Opens and closes this window.

items.name: New Session
items.help: Opens a terminal beside the session in focus, in its folder, and starts Claude Code in it.

items.name: End Session
items.help: Press it twice: the editor types /exit for the session in focus and closes its terminal.

items.name: Clear the Chat
items.help: Press it twice: the editor types /clear for the session in focus, at its prompt.
